name: brico-dab-zarzis
description: Brico Dab Zarzis — monorepo : site Next.js (web/) + API Express (server/) + base de données SQLite

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm start --prefix server" "npm start --prefix web"
